cases.title: a script that imports a package and has no lock is refused, where Windmill would infer its dependencies
cases.note: ADR 0002, validation 5: windmill-lite installs packages only from a lock and does not infer or generate one (Q-OF-5), so the build refuses a bundled script whose own source imports a package without a lock, a path script and an inline step alike. The bundler also fails to resolve the package.

export async function main() { return tag; }
